data.name: AccountNotFound
data.value: This account could not be found.

data.name: MailNotEnabled
data.value: Mail is not turned on for this server. Ask the server administrator to enable it.

data.name: MailServerHostnameInvalidFormat
data.value: This is not a valid host name. Enter a name such as mail.example.com.

data.name: MailServerHostnameTooLong
data.value: This host name is too long. A host name may be at most 253 characters.

data.name: MailServerHostnameReserved
data.value: This name cannot be used for a mail server because it is reserved and never names a public host.

data.name: MailMessageSizeOutOfRange
data.value: The largest message size must be between 1 and 512 MiB.

data.name: MailSpamScoresInvalid
data.value: The spam scores must be whole numbers from 0 to 100 and rise in order: greylist, then mark as spam, then reject.

data.name: MailQueueIdInvalid
data.value: This is not a valid mail queue identifier.

data.name: MailQueueEntryNotFound
data.value: This message is no longer in the mail queue.

data.name: MailDomainNotFound
data.value: This mail domain could not be found.

data.name: MailDomainTaken
data.value: This domain is already used for mail on this server.

data.name: MailDomainNotOwnedSite
data.value: Mail can only be set up for the main domain of one of your own sites. Add the site first.

data.name: MailDomainInvalid
data.value: This is not a valid domain. Enter a name such as example.com.

data.name: MailDomainTooLong
data.value: This domain name is too long for a mail domain.

data.name: MailDomainProvisioningFailed
data.value: The mail domain could not be set up on the server. Nothing was saved; try again.

data.name: MailboxNotFound
data.value: This mailbox could not be found.

data.name: MailboxTaken
data.value: This address is already used by a mailbox or an alias.

data.name: MailboxLocalPartInvalid
data.value: The part before the @ may contain lower-case letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters, and must start and end with a letter or digit.

data.name: MailboxQuotaOutOfRange
data.value: The mailbox size is outside the allowed range.

data.name: MailboxSendLimitOutOfRange
data.value: The hourly send limit is outside the allowed range.

data.name: MailboxSendLimitAbovePlan
data.value: The hourly send limit is higher than your plan allows.

data.name: MailboxLimitReached
data.value: Your plan does not allow more mailboxes. Remove one or choose a larger plan.

data.name: MailboxLimitReachedConcurrently
data.value: Your plan filled up while this mailbox was being created, so it was not kept. Remove a mailbox you no longer need and try again.

data.name: MailQuotaPoolExhausted
data.value: The mailbox sizes would add up to more than your plan allows in total.

data.name: MailboxProvisioningFailed
data.value: The mailbox could not be created on the server. Nothing was saved; try again.

data.name: MailPasswordTooWeak
data.value: The password must be 12 to 128 characters long and contain no control characters.

data.name: MailPasswordSchemeUnsupported
data.value: The mail server cannot verify the kind of password protection this panel produces yet. Ask the server administrator.

data.name: MailAliasNotFound
data.value: This alias could not be found.

data.name: MailAliasTaken
data.value: This address is already used by an alias or a mailbox.

data.name: MailAliasTargetInvalid
data.value: Enter at least one valid destination address. Each destination must be a plain address such as name@example.com.

data.name: MailAliasTargetLimit
data.value: An alias may have at most 20 destinations.

data.name: MailAliasKindMismatch
data.value: The kind does not match the destinations: an alias delivers only to your own domains, a forwarder needs at least one outside address.

data.name: MailAliasExternalTargetNotAllowed
data.value: The server administrator has not allowed forwarding to addresses outside your domains.

data.name: MailCatchAllConflict
data.value: This domain already has a catch-all address.

data.name: MailAliasProvisioningFailed
data.value: The alias could not be set up on the server. Nothing was saved; try again.

data.name: MailAutoresponderInvalid
data.value: The reply is not valid: the subject must be one line of at most 200 characters, and the text at most 4096 bytes with no line starting with a dot.
